explanation: The theorem is about the library's own definitions (IsChiefStep, IsCentralStep, IsNormalIn, commutatorMapHom), which come from the CFSG quasithin development. It states that the centralizer of c in Q gives a chief step below Q, under a commutator-map surjectivity hypothesis. Mathlib has no chief-factor or chief-step notion of this form. It also has no lemma that this commutator map c ↦ [c,y] is a homomorphism with kernel the centralizer. The proof is a long, substantive argument. I did not run searches in the Mathlib sources. This answer rests on the specialised nature of the statement.
